name: Sage Macro Faithfulness (Phase 6.2)
description: Multi-month macro questions gating tier-aware Sage assembly (Phase 6.2). Two arms (legacy Tier-2-only vs Tier-3 rollups) answer each question through the real gateway; the Phase 2 faithfulness judge scores each answer against its own arm's assembled context. Gate: faithfulness no-regression (eps 0.02), >=30% reduction in context chars per covered month, and >=75% expected-month coverage in the Tier-3 arm (guards against high-scoring 'no data' refusals). Curated 2026-11-28 against the live monthly_syntheses archive (2026-05 -> 2026-11; AI Security & Trust and AI-Assisted Software Engineering start 2026-06).
